name: Erik Severinghaus
letter:
Erik,

We got introduced via a referral when I searched for jobs, and you took the chance on me. I had a rocky start, to say the least, and would define that time as 'adolescent' where I would question things that didn't need questioning. I recall you even saying I was moments away from being fired.

I was ignorant (and still am in many ways), but you chose to take the hard path of patience and let me go through my growing pains, even though what was best for the company was likely to find a better-qualified candidate. Your leadership was a real gift for my life, and associating with you and the team helped me turn a chapter in how I viewed the world, especially the professional one. You are one of the most valuable people in my network, not because of your net worth (I have no idea what that is) but instead because you legitimately add value. I am worth more in the most literal sense because I was able to work under your leadership, and I truly thank you for that. I am so thankful for you and I hope I can grow myself into someone who is the tide that raises ships like you. Take care!

name: Aaron Huppert
letter:
Aaron,

You and I are on the same wavelength in so many ways, and I love you for that. From the inappropriate and ill-timed jokes to the laughter at things that shouldn't be laughed at, you were my go-to amigo at work.

You had one of the most challenging jobs in our company, by far the most difficult job on our team, and I feel you never got the credit you deserved for that. Two or three people had to take over your role, which shows just how big of a contributor you are. Even with the job you had, you were able to light up our team with your laugh, wit, and fun. I look down on you as a human for liking cats more than dogs. I wish we were still working together, but I am very happy you were able to find a role that you enjoy and is fulfilling to you.

Thank you for being the amazing person you are, Aaron. Your presence was and is absolutely a light in my life, and I am grateful for you.

Be well, and God bless you, Sally.

name: Amy Canham
letter:
Amy,

Wow, what an amazing friend you have been to me. You are a sister, a comedian, a friend, a real gem. From the first day I met your dad in the kitchen, murdering me with his eyes, I knew we were going to be best of buds. Late-night talks of life, adventures of driving, and simply being Ames and Steve are things that I look back on and feel happy about in my heart. I appreciate you and your friendship. God bless you, the hubby, and the fam.

I love you, Ames, and I hope to get to talk to you soon!

name: Amera M.
letter:
Amera,

What an awesome friend you are! I appreciate the way you've always found a way to keep in touch, the way you have always been there, and the way you make conversations enjoyable. You are such a brilliant individual and such a woman of strength. Your story has been a glory to glory one, and I respect you for it. I hope I get to introduce you to my wife someday and we can all kick it taking turns talking about how cool I am :-)

Take care, and I hope to talk soon!

name: Ben Dickey
letter:
Ben,

I feel so blessed to call you a friend. I have so much respect for your journey, your growth, and the way you show up. Every time I get to speak to you, you are fully present, fully there, and it's something I am quite jealous of you being able to do. The way you make others feel is as if there is no one else in the room, and they are the only one that matters. You have sovereign energy that is like a king. I truly believe you will make hundreds, if not millions of dollars, because of that energy of cool strength.

I respect and love you, Ben. Thanks for being a friend and a man that I'm able to reach out to in this journey of life. Every time I see you, I feel happy and believe we are going to be hanging on the beaches of the world soon enough.
